import json, random, subprocess, sys, time
MAIN='/workspace/submission/main.py'
rnd=random.Random(3)
svcs=['svc%02d'%i for i in range(24)]
def t(req, tag):
    line=json.dumps(req).encode()
    payload=b'\n'.join([line]*8)
    t0=time.time()
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I',MAIN], input=payload, capture_output=True)
    t1=time.time()
    outs=[json.loads(x) for x in p.stdout.split(b'\n') if x]
    print('%-14s rc=%d wall=%.2fs lines=%d -> %s' % (tag, p.returncode, t1-t0, len(outs),
          [o.get('error') or len(o['dfa']['accept']) for o in outs]))

at=[{'op':'contains','path':[rnd.choice(svcs) for _ in range(16)]} for _ in range(10)]
t({'services':svcs,'rules':[{'action':'allow','when':{'op':'and','args':at}}],'queries':[]}, 'contains16')
at2=[{'op':'endswith','path':[rnd.choice(svcs) for _ in range(16)]} for _ in range(10)]
t({'services':svcs,'rules':[{'action':'allow','when':{'op':'or','args':at2}}],'queries':[]}, 'endswith16')
at3=[{'op':'match','path':[rnd.choice(svcs) for _ in range(16)]} for _ in range(10)]
t({'services':svcs,'rules':[{'action':'allow','when':{'op':'or','args':at3}}],'queries':[]}, 'match16')
at4=[{'op':'startswith','path':[rnd.choice(svcs) for _ in range(16)]} for _ in range(10)]
t({'services':svcs,'rules':[{'action':'allow','when':{'op':'or','args':at4}}],'queries':[]}, 'startswith16')

at5=[{'op':op,'path':[rnd.choice(svcs) for _ in range(4)]} for op in
     ['contains','endswith','match','startswith']*2 + ['contains','endswith']]
t({'services':svcs,'rules':[{'action':'allow','when':{'op':'or','args':at5}},
                            {'action':'drop','when':at5[0]}],'queries':[]}, 'mixed4')
